page-background.name: Page background
page-background.use_for: The html, body and main wrapper of every marketing page.
page-background.not_for: Dashboard or auth screens, which keep their own canvas.
rules: Surfaces are white, blue or black only: never a gray page.
Text selection uses the blue 60 tint with white text.
Long running text gets text-wrap: pretty.

page-column.name: Content column
page-column.use_for: The centered column that holds every section's content, with side gutters.
page-column.not_for: Full-bleed bands; those span the viewport and put a column inside.
page-column.tailwind: mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-6 sm:px-8 md:px-10 lg:px-12
rules: Gutters step 24, 32, 40, 48px at sm, md and lg.
The site caps the column at 68.75rem (85vw below xl); the system uses 1152px.

section.name: Section
section.use_for: Each top-level band of a marketing page, with its vertical rhythm and ruled edges.
section.tailwind: relative bg-surface pt-10 pb-16 md:pt-12 md:pb-20
rules: Sections with a heading block: 40/64px on phones, 48/80px from md.
Sections are separated by a full-bleed 1px rule, never by gaps of gray.
One idea per section: heading, one or two lines of muted body, then content.

section-surface-blue.name: Blue section surface
section-surface-blue.use_for: A hero or band set on the brand blue, where text, marks and outlines turn white.
section-surface-blue.not_for: Body-heavy sections; blue carries a headline, one line and an action.
rules: Nothing on blue is tinted: copy is white, muted copy is white at 80%.
Rulers on blue use blue 70 lines and blue 40 nodes.
No gradients or textures on the blue.

section-surface-dark.name: Dark section surface
section-surface-dark.use_for: The footer and dark bands such as the latest updates rail.
rules: The site paints black at 90% (#191919); the system's black section is pure black.
Lines on dark are white at 15% (nearest neutral-80); nodes are neutral-60.

section-heading.name: Section heading block
section-heading.use_for: The heading, optional subheading and optional action at the top of a section.
section-heading.not_for: The page hero, which uses the display headline.
section-heading.tailwind: flex flex-col items-start gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between
rules: Left aligned on content pages; the action pill sits right of the heading from sm.
No eyebrow above the heading unless it names the structure.
A ruled line with dots at the column edges follows the block.

section-rule.name: Ruler and divider
section-rule.use_for: Hairlines on the column edges, the full-bleed rule between sections and between a heading and its content.
section-rule.tailwind: h-px border-0 bg-line mt-10 mb-8 md:mt-12
rules: Where a rule crosses a column edge, draw a solid 8px node in border-strong.
Nodes are opaque so the line never shows through.
The heading rule sits closer to its content (32px) than to the section above.

text-display.name: Hero headline
text-display.use_for: The one h1 in a page hero.
rules: 40px on phones, 48px at sm, 56px at lg.
The key phrase is blue, never bolder.
12 words or fewer, sentence case.

text-h1.name: Heading 1
text-h1.use_for: Page titles on content pages (contact, glossary, blog post) that are not a full hero.
rules: Scale down one step below md.
Emphasis is color, never weight.

text-h2.name: Heading 2 (section heading)
rules: 32px on phones, 44px from md.
Put the key phrase in a blue span; keep the rest black.
Sentence case, ends with a period on the home page.

text-h3.name: Heading 3
text-h3.use_for: Large card titles (product cards) and success messages.
text-h3.not_for: Small card titles in a three-up grid.
rules: Blog prose h2 maps to this size.

text-h4.name: Heading 4
text-h4.use_for: Titles on story and blog cards, and mobile menu rows.
rules: Clamp to two lines on cards.
Color follows the card surface (black on white, white on blue).

text-h5.name: Heading 5
text-h5.use_for: Small card titles, pricing plan names, aside headings and the FAQ question.
rules: Hero sublines on large heroes also use this size, in muted color.

text-highlight.name: Headline key phrase
text-highlight.use_for: The key phrase inside a heading that carries the emphasis.
rules: On blue the phrase stays white; on black it is blue 60.
Never bold, gradient, underline or a pill behind it.

text-lede.name: Lede and subheading
text-lede.use_for: The one or two lines under a section heading or hero headline.
rules: Black at 60% on white (neutral-60); white at 80% on blue.
24 words or fewer.
Large heroes set it at h5 size.

text-body.name: Body text
text-body.use_for: Paragraphs in cards, asides and descriptions.
text-body.not_for: Long-form articles, which use the prose recipe.
rules: Supporting body is muted (black at 70%); the item it describes is black.
Never set readable text with opacity on a parent.

text-small.name: Small text
text-small.use_for: Card summaries, dates, form notes and supporting lines.
rules: Dates on cards take the card's text color, not gray.

text-caption.name: Caption
text-caption.use_for: Fine print under a button, figure captions and the announcement on phones.
text-caption.not_for: Labels a user must read to act.
rules: Sits centered under the primary pill: "No card required".

text-eyebrow.name: Eyebrow and overline
text-eyebrow.use_for: A short structural label above a block, such as the "Backed by Y Combinator" line or a group label in a menu.
text-eyebrow.not_for: Decoration above every heading; the brand avoids eyebrows without a structural purpose.
rules: Sentence case, no uppercase tracking, no blue fill.
The legacy uppercase blue eyebrow is off-brand; restyle it to this.

text-prose.name: Article prose
text-prose.use_for: Blog posts, guides and legal pages rendered from Markdown.
rules: Headings inside are regular weight, black: h1 at h2 size, h2 at h3, h3 at h4, h4 to h6 at h5.
Strong and table headers stay regular weight, black.
Images and tables sit in a white card inside the blue glass ring.

code-inline.name: Inline code
code-inline.use_for: Code spans in prose and descriptions.
code-inline.tailwind: font-mono text-body-sm px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-control-sm bg-tint text-navy-90
rules: Blue on blue tint, no border.
IBM Plex Mono, never Doto.

blockquote.name: Blockquote and pull quote
blockquote.use_for: Quotes in articles and customer quotes set as text.
blockquote.tailwind: relative pl-8 not-italic text-h5 text-fg before:absolute before:inset-y-0 before:left-0 before:w-2 before:rounded-card before:bg-tint
rules: The rule is an 8px bar of the glass ring color with the card radius, drawn as ::before.
No italics, no quote glyph, no gray fill.

stat-figure.name: Stat figure
stat-figure.use_for: A section's one large number, prices and animated counts.
stat-figure.not_for: Headings, body, buttons, labels or navigation.
rules: Doto only for the figure; the words beside it stay Rethink Sans.
Prices use Doto at h2 size, extra bold, black.
Every number links to its benchmark or source.

list-bulleted.name: Bulleted list
list-bulleted.use_for: Unordered lists in prose and feature lists in cards.
rules: In prose each item gets a 20px blue rounded square with a dotted check, 32px indent.
In cards the marker is a solid 8px blue dot.
Ordered list markers are blue.

button-primary.name: Primary button
button-primary.use_for: The one main action on a screen, usually "Start for free": a filled black pill.
button-primary.not_for: A second action next to it; that one is the secondary outline pill.

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out), border-color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-primary.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-pill border border-action bg-action px-5 py-3 font-sans text-button text-on-action transition-colors duration-200 hover:border-action-hover hover:bg-action-hover active:scale-[0.97] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:border-line disabled:bg-frame disabled:text-fg-subtle motion-reduce:transition-none
rules: One per screen; label 5 words or fewer, sentence case, regular weight.
Black on white and black on blue alike; no bevel or gradient.
Hover only under (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine); no transition with reduced motion.

button-secondary.name: Secondary button
button-secondary.use_for: Every action other than the primary one on white: a blue outline pill.

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out), border-color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-secondary.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-pill border border-brand bg-surface px-5 py-3 text-button text-brand transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-tint active:scale-[0.97] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:border-line disabled:bg-frame disabled:text-fg-subtle motion-reduce:transition-none
rules: 1px blue border, blue label, white fill; hover fills with blue 10.
A trailing arrow icon is 16px and nudges 2px on hover.
Gate hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

button-quiet.name: Tertiary button
button-quiet.use_for: A low-emphasis action beside the primary in the header, such as "Book demo" or "Log in".
button-quiet.not_for: Body content actions; use the secondary pill.

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), box-shadow var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-quiet.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-pill border border-line bg-surface px-5 py-2.5 text-body-sm text-fg shadow-thumb transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-surface-subtle active:scale-[0.97] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
rules: Gray hairline, black label, white fill; hover is the off-white panel.
Header buttons are 42px tall; the header forces a full pill radius.

button-on-brand.name: Button on blue
button-on-brand.use_for: Secondary actions on a blue surface: a white outline pill.
button-on-brand.not_for: The primary action on blue, which stays the filled black pill.
button-on-brand.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-pill border border-on-brand bg-transparent px-5 py-3 text-button text-on-brand transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-blue-90 active:scale-[0.97] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
rules: White border and label, no fill; hover is white at 12% over blue.
Focus ring is white on blue so it reaches 3:1.

button-on-dark.name: Button on dark
button-on-dark.use_for: An action on the black footer or a dark band: a white pill with black label.
button-on-dark.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-pill border border-white bg-white px-5 py-3 text-button text-black transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-shine active:scale-[0.97] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline-white disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
rules: Focus outline is white with a 4px offset on dark.
Quiet links on dark are white at 60% instead of a button.

button-small.name: Small button
button-small.use_for: Pill actions inside menus, cards and panel headers ("View all stories", "Explore").
rules: Apply on top of the primary or secondary recipe; colors come from the variant.
Icons shrink to 12px.

button-icon.name: Icon button
button-icon.use_for: Icon-only actions: the submit arrow in an input, copy, close and the mobile menu toggle.
button-icon.not_for: Actions that need a word to be understood.
button-icon.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-pill bg-brand p-2.5 text-on-brand transition-[filter] duration-150 ease-out hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.97] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40
rules: Always has an aria-label.
Submit inside a field is filled blue; neutral toggles are transparent with a neutral-5 hover.
Touch targets reach 44px.

link-inline.name: Text link in body copy
link-inline.use_for: Links inside paragraphs, prose and form notes.
link-inline.tailwind: text-brand no-underline underline-offset-4 hover:underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
rules: Blue, regular weight, no underline at rest.
Prose links do not underline on hover at all; form-note links do.

link-nav.name: Nav link
link-nav.use_for: Top-level links and dropdown triggers in the header.
link-nav.not_for: Links inside the mega menu panel.
link-nav.tailwind: flex items-center gap-1 rounded-pill px-2 py-2 xl:px-3.5 text-body-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-fg-muted transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-surface-subtle hover:text-brand aria-[current=page]:text-fg aria-expanded:text-fg focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
rules: The hover background is one shared neutral-5 pill that glides between items (200ms, emphasized ease).
A dropdown chevron is 16px and rotates 180deg when open.
Current page turns black, not blue.

link-footer.name: Footer link
link-footer.use_for: Link columns and legal links on the dark footer.
link-footer.tailwind: block py-0.5 text-body-sm text-neutral-30 transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-fg-inverse focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline-white
rules: The site uses white at 60% and medium weight; the system uses neutral-30 regular. Keep regular weight.
Column titles are white, body-sm.

link-arrow.name: Link with arrow
link-arrow.use_for: "Read their story", "Read the docs", "All customer stories" style links that lead somewhere.
link-arrow.tailwind: group inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-body-sm text-brand focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus [&>svg]:size-3.5 [&>svg]:transition-transform [&>svg]:duration-150 hover:[&>svg]:translate-x-0.5 motion-reduce:[&>svg]:transition-none
rules: The arrow is 14px and moves 2px right on hover (transform, 150ms); external links use an up-right arrow moving up and right.
Muted variant: black at 70% turning black on hover.

chip-link.name: Chip and tag
chip-link.use_for: Small pills naming things: API chips, "what you can build" tags, category tags.
chip-link.not_for: Status or counts; use the badge.

css.transition: border-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

chip-link.tailwind: inline-flex items-center rounded-pill border border-line-strong bg-surface px-3 py-1 text-body-sm text-fg-muted transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:border-brand hover:text-brand focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
rules: Only linked chips get hover.
Static tags drop to a 10% black inset ring on the site.

badge.name: Badge
badge.use_for: A short label on a plan, price or card: "Recommended", "Save 20%", "New".
badge.not_for: Stacking several badges; one per item.
badge.tailwind: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-pill bg-tint px-2.5 py-0.5 text-caption font-medium text-navy-90 normal-case
rules: Blue on blue tint; neutral badges are neutral-5 with muted text.
Sentence case: the site's uppercase "RECOMMENDED" breaks the voice rules.

status-pill.name: Status pill
status-pill.use_for: Live status such as "All systems operational" or compliance status, with a dot.

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

status-pill.tailwind: inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-pill border border-neutral-80 px-3 py-1.5 text-caption text-neutral-30 transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-fg-inverse before:size-2 before:rounded-full before:bg-success
rules: The dot is a solid 8px circle in the status color.
On white use border-default and muted text.

label.name: Field label
label.use_for: The visible label above an input, textarea or select.
rules: "(optional)" is appended in the same muted color.
Every field keeps a label; hide it visually with sr-only only when the placeholder says the same.

input-text.name: Text input
input-text.use_for: Single-line fields in contact, application and tool forms.
input-text.not_for: The hero URL demo field, which has its own recipe.
input-text.tailwind: w-full min-h-11 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-body text-fg placeholder:text-fg-subtle transition-colors duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:border-brand focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-surface-subtle disabled:text-fg-muted aria-[invalid=true]:border-danger
rules: At least 16px text so iOS does not zoom.
44px minimum height.
Locked fields show a 14px lock icon on the right.

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.tailwind: w-full resize-none rounded-card border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-body text-fg placeholder:text-fg-subtle transition-colors duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:border-brand focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus aria-[invalid=true]:border-danger
rules: Six rows on the contact form; the site disables resize.

select.name: Select
select.tailwind: w-full appearance-none rounded-card border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-body text-fg transition-colors duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:border-brand focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
rules: Same box as the text input; add a 16px chevron in text-subtle on the right.

checkbox.name: Checkbox and radio
checkbox.not_for: On and off settings; marketing pages have none.
checkbox.tailwind: size-4 rounded-sm border border-line-strong accent-brand focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
rules: Radios use a full circle radius.
The label beside it is body-sm, black, 8px away.

help-text.name: Help text
help-text.use_for: A hint under a field or at the end of a form.
rules: Link the field to it with aria-describedby.

field-error.name: Error message
field-error.use_for: Validation and request errors under a field or form.
rules: Use role=alert and set aria-invalid on the field.
Say what to do, in plain words.

input-with-button.name: Inline capture field
input-with-button.use_for: A search, email capture or "ask anything" field with its submit button inside one white card.
input-with-button.tailwind: flex items-center gap-5 rounded-card bg-surface px-5 py-4 shadow-card outline-8 outline-tint focus-within:outline-blue-20
rules: The input inside is borderless and transparent, 17px, placeholder black at 40%.
The submit is the filled blue icon button.
The whole card sits inside the blue glass ring.

segmented-control.name: Segmented control
segmented-control.use_for: Picking one option inside a demo or the billing period toggle.
segmented-control.not_for: Switching page content panels; use tabs.
rules: Segments are 6px radius, body-sm; inactive is neutral-50, hovering to neutral-70.
Selection changes immediately; color transitions only.

card-ring.name: Card glass ring
card-ring.use_for: The translucent blue frame that wraps every white card, table, code window and FAQ item on white.
card-ring.not_for: Cards on blue, which take a blue 80 ring.
rules: Draw the ring as a padded wrapper, not a border or shadow, so its outer corner keeps the card radius.
The negative margin keeps layout size unchanged.
On blue the ring is blue 80; on the hero it is white at 30%.

card.name: Card
card.use_for: Static white content boxes: trust items, contact panels, CTA offer box.
card.not_for: Gray fills; the brand never uses a gray card.
card.tailwind: relative flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-card bg-surface p-6 md:p-8 text-fg ring-1 ring-hairline
rules: Wrap it in the card glass ring.
24px padding, 32px from md.
Grids of two or three cards, 24px gaps.

card-clickable.name: Clickable card
card-clickable.use_for: A card whose whole surface is one link (trust items, blog cards, featured stories).

css.transition: box-shadow var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out), background-color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out)

card-clickable.tailwind: relative block rounded-card bg-surface ring-1 ring-hairline transition-shadow duration-200 ease-out hover:shadow-ring-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
rules: Hover never moves or scales the card; only color and the ring change.
Its pill or arrow inside takes its own hover when the card is hovered.
Stretch the link over the card with an ::after inset 0.

card-feature.name: Feature card
card-feature.use_for: Product or feature cards with a title, description, tags and an explore pill.
card-feature.tailwind: relative flex flex-col gap-10 overflow-hidden rounded-card bg-surface p-6 md:p-8 ring-1 ring-hairline
rules: Title in h3 with the explore pill on the same row; description body-lg in neutral-60.
Illustrations come from the dot grid, never stock icons.

card-blue.name: Blue card
card-blue.use_for: Customer story cards, featured product in menus and blue blog covers.
card-blue.not_for: More than one blue card per row of white ones.
card-blue.tailwind: relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-card bg-brand p-6 sm:p-8 text-on-brand
rules: Everything on it is white: date body-sm, title h4, summary body-lg.
Its action is the white outline pill.
Ring around it is blue 80 when it needs one.

card-pricing.name: Pricing card
card-pricing.use_for: One plan in the pricing grid.
card-pricing.not_for: Feature comparison; that is a table.
rules: Plans share one ringed card split by 1px hairlines (gap-px over border color), not separate floating cards.
Name h5, description body-sm neutral-60, price in Doto h2 above the button.
Quota boxes: 8px radius, 6% black inset ring, rows split by 6% black hairlines.

card-pricing-featured.name: Highlighted plan
card-pricing-featured.use_for: The recommended or most popular plan.
rules: The popular plan's button is the filled black pill; every other plan uses the blue outline pill.
Add one "Recommended" badge; no scale, glow or lift.
The site keeps the card white and changes only the button; the system tints the column.

media-frame.name: Image and media frame
media-frame.use_for: Standalone screenshots, images and videos in articles and sections.
media-frame.tailwind: mx-auto my-8 block h-auto w-[calc(100%-1rem)] rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 ring-8 ring-tint
rules: The media itself is the white card; the ring is an 8px spread shadow.
Captions are body-sm, muted, 20px below.
No photos with their own backgrounds as brand imagery.

code-window.name: Code block and terminal
code-window.use_for: Code samples, agent setup prompts and terminal output.
code-window.tailwind: overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-neutral-80 bg-surface-inverse text-fg-inverse font-mono text-body-sm text-left
rules: Header row: 44px, three 8px dots (first solid blue, two hollow), a caption label, a small outline Copy pill on the right, 1px divider.
Body padding 20px, IBM Plex Mono.
Sits inside the card glass ring on white.

logo-wall-item.name: Logo wall item
logo-wall-item.use_for: Customer logos in a strip or grid.
logo-wall-item.tailwind: flex items-center justify-center text-center text-h5 text-fg-subtle
rules: Logos are single color (neutral-50 on white), never full color.
On blue panels the site redraws logos as white dots.
Six per row from lg, 24px by 32px gaps.

testimonial-card.name: Testimonial card
testimonial-card.use_for: A customer quote with name and company in a grid.
testimonial-card.tailwind: relative flex flex-col rounded-card bg-surface p-6 ring-1 ring-hairline transition-colors duration-200 ease-out hover:bg-surface-subtle
rules: Quote body text in black, attribution body-sm muted along the bottom.
Highlighted phrases turn blue on hover; nothing moves.
Rows share the tallest card's height.

faq-item.name: FAQ item
faq-item.use_for: One question and answer, as a details/summary card.
faq-item.tailwind: relative overflow-hidden rounded-card bg-surface shadow-card transition-colors duration-200 ease-out hover:bg-surface-subtle
rules: Summary: 16px by 20px padding, body medium, black; a dot plus that turns into a cross on the right.
Answer: body-sm muted, opens by block-size over 250ms in-out with opacity; instant with reduced motion.
Each item sits in the card glass ring, 20px apart.

callout-banner.name: Announcement bar and callout
callout-banner.use_for: The strip above the header and inline notices that link somewhere.
callout-banner.tailwind: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 border-b border-hairline bg-surface-subtle px-4 py-1 text-center text-caption sm:text-body-sm text-fg transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-frame focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus
rules: 46px tall above the header; caption on phones, body-sm from sm.
Announcements start with "New:".
No dismiss buttons, gradients or emoji.

cta-card.name: Closing call to action
cta-card.use_for: The last band before the footer: headline, one line, and the free credits offer box.
cta-card.tailwind: relative grid items-center gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_21rem] lg:gap-12 overflow-hidden rounded-card bg-surface p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-12 ring-1 ring-hairline
rules: A white card in the glass ring over the blue dot field, never a blue gradient band.
Offer box: Doto credits figure, h5 label, outline pill full width, docs link below.

tabs.name: Tabs and filter pills
tabs.use_for: Switching FAQ categories, code languages or filtering a listing.

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out)

tabs.tailwind: inline-flex items-center rounded-pill border border-transparent px-2.5 py-1.5 sm:px-5 sm:py-2.5 text-caption sm:text-body text-neutral-60 transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-tint hover:text-fg aria-selected:border-brand aria-selected:bg-surface aria-selected:text-brand focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus motion-reduce:transition-none
rules: Selected is a blue outline pill; the site glides one pill between triggers on a spring.
Listing filters select to a filled black pill instead.
Panels switch instantly.

header.name: Header (top of page)
header.use_for: The sticky top nav before the page scrolls: logo, links, Book demo, Start for free.
header.tailwind: sticky top-0 z-[1000] flex h-18 w-full items-center justify-center bg-transparent
rules: At the top it runs edge to edge with no fill over the hero.
Three-column grid: logo left, links centered, two actions right; below 880px, logo and menu toggle.
Header buttons are 42px pills: tertiary Book demo, primary Start for free.

header-scrolled.name: Header (scrolled)
header-scrolled.use_for: The header once the page scrolls: it gathers into a floating white pill inside a frosted ring.

css.border: var(--ds-space-1-5) solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-color-brand) 10%, transparent)
css.transition: border-radius var(--ds-duration-moderate) var(--ds-easing-emphasized), background-color var(--ds-duration-moderate) var(--ds-easing-emphasized), box-shadow var(--ds-duration-base) var(--ds-easing-out)

header-scrolled.tailwind: top-2 mx-auto box-border h-[calc(var(--ds-space-16)+var(--ds-space-1))] w-[min(100%-var(--ds-space-4),calc(var(--ds-layout-content-width)+var(--ds-space-24)))] rounded-pill border-6 border-brand/10 bg-surface bg-clip-padding px-4 shadow-floating backdrop-blur-[var(--ds-space-4)] transition-[border-radius,background-color,box-shadow] duration-250 ease-emphasized motion-reduce:transition-none
rules: A white pill 68px tall, 8px from the top of the window, inside a 6px ring of brand blue at 10% that is see-through and frosted (the background is clipped to the padding box, the blur shows through the ring). Never an opaque pale outline.
A 1px hairline and a soft drop shadow (shadow-floating) carry the edge over white sections.

Inside: logo left, links centered as link-nav (body-sm, medium, muted, 32px tall pills), two 42px pill actions right (tertiary, then primary). The items keep their size and place while the bar morphs.
On phones (under 880px) the pill is 52px with a 5px ring: logo and the menu toggle only.
No transition with reduced motion.

nav-dropdown-panel.name: Mega menu panel
nav-dropdown-panel.use_for: The Products, Use cases and Customers dropdown panels under the header.

css.transition: opacity var(--ds-duration-moderate) var(--ds-easing-out), translate var(--ds-duration-moderate) var(--ds-easing-out), scale var(--ds-duration-moderate) var(--ds-easing-out)

nav-dropdown-panel.tailwind: origin-top rounded-card bg-tint p-1.5 shadow-floating transition-[opacity,translate,scale] duration-250 ease-out data-[state=closed]:pointer-events-none data-[state=closed]:-translate-y-2 data-[state=closed]:scale-95 data-[state=closed]:opacity-0 motion-reduce:transition-none
rules: Inside is a white 8px-radius panel; items are 12px padded rows with a 36px blue icon tile, body medium title, body-sm muted description.
Item hover is one shared 4% black highlight that glides between items.
A footer strip in neutral-5 with a 6% hairline lists developer links.

mobile-menu.name: Mobile menu
mobile-menu.use_for: The full-height menu that opens under the header below 880px.
mobile-menu.tailwind: absolute inset-x-0 top-full flex flex-col overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-surface px-6 pt-4 pb-6 text-fg border-t border-line
rules: Rows: 52px min height, h4 size regular, 8px radius, neutral-5 hover; open section turns blue.
Sublinks body-lg muted; two actions pinned at the bottom: tertiary and primary pills, 48px.
Reveal uses clip-path; reduced motion shows it at once.

footer.name: Footer
footer.use_for: The site footer: brand line, compliance and status, four link columns, legal bar, dotted wordmark.
rules: Summary row split from links by a 1px white 15% rule (neutral-80).
Column titles body-sm white; links use the footer link recipe.
Legal links Terms, DPA, Privacy and SOC badges stay.

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.use_for: The trail above a title on glossary, company and article pages.
breadcrumb.tailwind: flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-body-sm text-fg-muted [&_a]:rounded-sm [&_a]:transition-colors [&_a:hover]:text-brand
rules: Separator is a slash in neutral-20, aria-hidden.
No uppercase or tracking.

table.name: Table
table.use_for: Credit costs, comparison and any tabular data on marketing pages.
table.tailwind: w-full border-separate border-spacing-0 overflow-hidden rounded-card bg-surface ring-1 ring-hairline text-body text-left [&_th]:px-6 [&_th]:py-4 md:[&_th]:px-8 [&_th]:font-regular [&_th]:text-neutral-60 [&_td]:px-6 [&_td]:py-3.5 md:[&_td]:px-8 [&_td]:tabular-nums [&_tr]:border-b [&_tr]:border-hairline
rules: A white card in the glass ring; no zebra stripes, no row hover, no uppercase headers.
The first column is black, figures are blue and right aligned.
A highlighted comparison column gets a 10% blue header and 3% blue cells.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.use_for: A short definition on hover or focus, such as a dashed term in a pricing line.
tooltip.not_for: Anything a user must read to complete a task.
tooltip.tailwind: rounded-sm bg-surface-inverse px-2 py-1 text-caption text-fg-inverse shadow-tooltip max-w-72 transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out
rules: Fade only, 150ms; no zoom from small scale.
Triggered terms get a dashed 25% black underline.
Show on focus too, not only hover.

dropdown-menu.name: Action menu
dropdown-menu.use_for: Small menus opened from a button, such as "Connect Context.dev".
dropdown-menu.tailwind: w-60 rounded-card bg-surface p-1.5 text-fg shadow-floating popover-in [&_[role=menuitem]]:rounded-control [&_[role=menuitem]]:px-2.5 [&_[role=menuitem]]:py-2 [&_[role=menuitem]]:text-body-sm [&_[role=menuitem]:focus]:bg-surface-subtle
rules: Opens from scale 0.97 and 4px up toward its trigger origin over 150ms; no animation with reduced motion.
Items: 8px radius, body-sm, 4% black focus highlight.

dialog.name: Modal dialog
dialog.use_for: A focused task over the page, such as a video or a help form.
dialog.tailwind: fixed w-full max-w-lg rounded-window bg-surface p-6 text-fg shadow-drawer content-in backdrop:bg-scrim
rules: Title h5, description body-sm muted.
Opens with a 200ms fade and slight rise; never from scale 0.
Portals render outside the brand scope: set the brand font and colors on the dialog itself.

toast.name: Toast
toast.use_for: Brief confirmation after an action, such as "Copied to clipboard".
toast.tailwind: rounded-card bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-body-sm text-fg shadow-floating
rules: Marketing pages mostly confirm inline (the label changes to "Copied") instead of a toast.
Use aria-live polite.

app-canvas.name: App canvas
app-canvas.use_for: The window background every product page and the sidebar sit on.
app-canvas.not_for: Card or panel backgrounds; those are white surfaces on the canvas.
rules: Put ds-product on html so the product tokens (12.6px body, 10px card radius, dark theme) apply.
The product root is 15px (font-size 93.75% on html); rem sizes scale with it.
Dark canvas equals the card surface, so cards read by their hairline, not by contrast.

app-shell.name: App shell
app-shell.use_for: The full-window frame: a sidebar beside a column that holds the top bar and the scrolling page.
app-shell.not_for: Marketing layouts; the shell has no outer frame or card around it.
app-shell.tailwind: ds-product flex h-dvh overflow-hidden bg-canvas font-sans text-fg
rules: Main column: flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden; the page area under the top bar is flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1.
Each page scrolls itself with scrollbar-thin scrollbar-stable flex-1 overflow-y-auto.
No frame, border or card around the shell; it fills the window edge to edge.

app-page-column.name: Page column
app-page-column.use_for: The content column of every product page, nudged left beside the sidebar so the gaps either side balance.
app-page-column.not_for: The playground, which uses playground-column (400px to 600px).
app-page-column.tailwind: page-column flex flex-col gap-6 px-8 pt-8 pb-10
rules: 880px max; use the page-column utility rather than the raw calc.
Top padding by page type: overview pt-2, forms, usage and settings pt-6, lists pt-8, hero lists pt-12.
Overview is px-4 until its container is 2xl, then px-8.

app-page-header.name: Page header
app-page-header.use_for: The head of every product page: a centered title, one muted sentence, then the page's single brand action if it has one.
app-page-header.not_for: A left title with right-aligned actions; shipped pages never use that.
rules: Title is app-text-page-title; the sentence under it is mt-1 max-w-xl text-body-sm text-balance text-fg-muted.
Actions sit centered under the sentence, brand first, then at most one outline (for example "Read docs").
Detail pages head with a breadcrumb instead and keep the title for screen readers.

app-page-stack.name: Page section stack
app-page-stack.use_for: The vertical rhythm between a page's sections, and between cards in a grid.
app-page-stack.not_for: Spacing inside a card; card padding has its own recipes.
rules: 24px between a page's sections; 12px (gap-3) between cards in a grid and on the overview.
28px (gap-7) between form fields, 24px (gap-6) between fields in a dialog, 32px (gap-8) on the playground, 20px on short windows.
Dense by default: 12px to 20px card padding, 32px rows; tighten on laptop-height windows with short: rather than shrinking type.

app-text-page-title.name: Page title
app-text-page-title.use_for: The one title at the top of a product page.
app-text-page-title.not_for: Card titles or dialog titles; those are smaller.
rules: 21px at weight 450, a step above body so it leads without shouting.
Sentence case, no period.
Never bold, never Doto.

app-text-section-label.name: Section title
app-text-section-label.use_for: The small quiet label above a group of cards or a gray detail list (settings sections, detail sections).
app-text-section-label.not_for: Card titles inside a card header.
rules: Settings sections use text-body-sm; detail list sections use text-caption (data-size=sm).
Sits 8px above its card (flex-col gap-2).
Not uppercase, not bold.

app-text-card-title.name: Card title
app-text-card-title.use_for: The title in a card header or a stat card, at the main UI size.
rules: Regular weight, sentence case ("Recent requests", not "Recent Requests").
Dialog titles step up to text-h5 (18px).
Stat card labels use text-caption text-fg-muted instead.

app-text-body.name: Body text
app-text-body.use_for: Running text, table cells, sidebar items, buttons and fields: the dashboard's main size.
app-text-body.not_for: Help lines under fields, which are caption.
rules: 12.6px, line height 1.3. Descriptions use text-fg-muted; quiet metadata text-fg-subtle.
Emphasis is color (text-fg inside muted text) or position, never bold.
Wrap long sentences with text-balance or text-pretty.

app-text-caption.name: Caption
app-text-caption.use_for: Help lines, table headers, card footers, timestamps and small chips.
app-text-caption.not_for: Tooltips and tags, which are micro.
rules: 12px. text-fg-subtle is #707070 in light so small text still passes AA.
Stat card labels use the muted tone.

app-text-micro.name: Micro text
app-text-micro.use_for: The smallest text: tooltips, sidebar group labels, step numbers, plan chips.
app-text-micro.not_for: Anything a user must read to act.
rules: 11px. The dashboard's 10px chip text maps here.
Mono uppercase status labels also use this size.

app-text-mono.name: Mono and code
app-text-mono.use_for: IDs, keys, URLs, request inputs, code and JSON.
app-text-mono.not_for: Prose or figures; figures stay in Rethink Sans.
rules: IBM Plex Mono at 12px; inline values in rows at 11px (text-micro).
Code blocks wrap (never scroll sideways); syntax: strings text-accent, keywords and flags text-navy-60, numbers and booleans text-blue-70.
Code line height is 1.65 in the dashboard (see missing_tokens).

app-text-figure.name: Figures
app-text-figure.use_for: Numbers in cells, counts, credits, durations and stat values.
app-text-figure.not_for: Dot charts and the credits glyph, the only Doto uses.
rules: Rethink Sans with tabular numbers, right-aligned in numeric columns.
Formatted (1,343), short periods (30d), en dash ranges (1–10 of 248).
A big stat figure is font-medium text-h4 leading-none with a text-caption suffix in text-fg-subtle.

app-text-label.name: Field label
app-text-label.use_for: The label above a form control.
rules: Never add "(optional)"; say "Optional." at the end of the help line.
A quiet action beside the label ("Change") is text-accent hover:underline.

app-button-brand.name: Brand button
app-button-brand.use_for: The one main action on a page or form ("Create API key", "Submit batch", the playground run button).
app-button-brand.not_for: Any second action on the same page or form; that is outline or ghost.
app-button-brand.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control h-8 px-3.5 font-sans text-body-sm outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover active:scale-97 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 bg-brand text-on-brand hover:bg-blue-90
rules: One per page or form. When it spends credits, show the cost in a chip inside it: h-5 rounded-pill bg-white/15 px-2 text-caption shadow inset hairline of white/20.
Filled brand stays #2563EB in dark so the white label keeps 5.17:1.
Plus icon size-3.5 stroke 1.75 before the label; arrow icon after on forms.

app-button-primary.name: Filled black button
app-button-primary.use_for: A filled action inside a card where blue would compete with the page's brand button ("Copy" on the prompt card, "Done" in dialogs).
app-button-primary.not_for: The page's main action; that is the brand button.
app-button-primary.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control h-8 px-3.5 font-sans text-body-sm outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover active:scale-97 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 bg-action text-on-action hover:bg-action-hover
rules: Inverts in dark (light fill, dark label) through the action tokens.
At most one per card.

app-button-outline.name: Outline button
app-button-outline.use_for: Secondary actions: "View plans", "Read docs", "Upload photo", "Cancel deletion".
app-button-outline.not_for: The main action, or quiet toolbar actions (ghost).
app-button-outline.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control h-8 px-3.5 font-sans text-body-sm outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover active:scale-97 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 border border-line-strong text-fg hover:border-fg
rules: Hover darkens the border to the text color; no fill.
Default variant when unsure.

app-button-outline-brand.name: Brand outline button
app-button-outline-brand.use_for: Small upsell or helper actions that point somewhere ("Upgrade" in a settings row, "Increase limit", "Fill in fields").
app-button-outline-brand.not_for: A page with a brand button already competing nearby.
app-button-outline-brand.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control h-8 px-3.5 font-sans text-body-sm outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover active:scale-97 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 border border-accent text-accent hover:bg-blue-10
rules: Text and edge use blue-80 in dark (text-accent) for contrast.
Mini form: h-7 rounded-control-sm px-3.

app-button-ghost.name: Ghost button
app-button-ghost.use_for: Quiet actions: "Cancel" in dialog footers, toolbar text buttons, "Previous" and "Next".
app-button-ghost.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control h-8 px-3.5 font-sans text-body-sm outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover active:scale-97 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 text-fg-muted hover:bg-wash/4 hover:text-fg
rules: Hover is a 4% wash of black (white in dark), never a lift.
Toolbar ghost buttons drop to px-3.

app-button-size-md.name: Button, form size
app-button-size-md.use_for: The taller button for a form's submit or a page's main action at the end of a form.
app-button-size-md.not_for: Toolbars, dialogs and table areas, which use the default 32px size.
rules: Combine with a variant recipe; only height and padding change.
Default (sm) size: h-8 px-3.5.

app-icon-button.name: Icon button
app-icon-button.use_for: Square ghost buttons with one icon: close, row menus, search, reveal, copy.
app-icon-button.not_for: An icon with no label or tooltip; every icon button gets both.
app-icon-button.tailwind: grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-control text-fg-subtle outline-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-wash/4 hover:text-fg focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40
rules: Icon size-4 stroke 1.5; small form size-7 with a size-3.5 icon.
Holds the hover look while its menu is open.
Needs aria-label and a tooltip with the same words.

app-button-danger.name: Danger button
app-button-danger.use_for: The trigger in a danger zone row that opens a delete confirmation ("Delete account").
app-button-danger.not_for: Confirming a delete; confirmation is the hold button.
app-button-danger.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control h-8 px-3.5 font-sans text-body-sm outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover active:scale-97 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 h-9 px-4 bg-danger text-white hover:bg-danger/90
rules: Only in the settings danger zone; it opens a dialog whose confirm is a hold button.
Deletion is then scheduled with a grace period and the row offers to cancel it.

app-hold-button.name: Hold to confirm button
app-hold-button.use_for: Confirming anything destructive: delete key, delete account, revoke invite.
app-hold-button.not_for: Reversible actions (enable, resend), which are plain clicks.
app-hold-button.tailwind: inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control h-8 px-3.5 font-sans text-body-sm outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 relative overflow-hidden select-none border border-danger text-danger
rules: A bg-danger layer under the label scales from the left (origin-left scaleX 0 to 1) linearly over the hold, 1200ms in the button, 1500ms for row-menu holds; it releases in 150ms ease-out.
Label swaps to "Keep holding…" and turns white while held.
Use "Hold to delete" style labels; never a plain click for destructive actions.

app-link-arrow.name: Arrow link
app-link-arrow.use_for: A quiet way out of a card to the page behind it ("View all", "Manage keys", "Read the docs").
app-link-arrow.not_for: Links inside running text; use app-link-inline.
app-link-arrow.tailwind: group flex h-6 shrink-0 items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap text-caption text-fg-muted underline-offset-4 decoration-fg/25 transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-fg hover:underline focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover
rules: Ends with an up-right arrow size-3.5 that nudges 1px up and right on hover (translate, 150ms, emphasized easing).
Underline sits under the words only.
Inside a bigger link (a card, a row) the words underline on group hover with no color swap.

app-link-inline.name: Inline link
app-link-inline.use_for: A link inside a sentence or beside a label ("Talk to sales", "Change", "Create or enable one").
rules: Brand text, underline on hover only.
blue-80 in dark through the text-brand token.

app-copy-button.name: Copy button
app-copy-button.use_for: Copying a value in place: request IDs, emails, keys, code.
app-copy-button.not_for: Copying a whole prompt as the card's main action (filled black button).
app-copy-button.tailwind: grid size-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-control text-fg-subtle outline-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-wash/5 hover:text-fg focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover data-copied:text-success
rules: Copy icon size-3.5 stroke 1.5; swaps to a check in success green for 1.5s, tooltip "Copied".
A failed clipboard write shows nothing rather than a false check.
In code cards: size-8 at the code's top-right corner.

app-input.name: Text input
app-input.use_for: Any single-line field in a form, dialog or settings card.
app-input.not_for: Fields inside the parameters panel, which are filled gray with no border.
app-input.tailwind: h-10 w-full rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-3.5 text-body-sm text-fg outline-none transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 ease-out placeholder:text-fg-subtle hover:border-line-strong focus:border-brand disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-danger
rules: Focus is the border turning brand blue; no outline.
Numbers add tabular-nums; paths and URLs add font-mono at 12px.
Read-only values use text-fg-muted. Errors show only after the first submit.

app-input-with-button.name: Input with button inside
app-input-with-button.use_for: A field that holds its own action: the playground composer, the try box, the team invite field.
app-input-with-button.not_for: Ordinary form fields with a submit button below.
app-input-with-button.tailwind: flex h-12 cursor-text items-center gap-3 rounded-control border border-transparent bg-surface pr-2 pl-4 shadow-card transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 ease-out hover:shadow-glass-hover has-[input:focus]:border-brand has-[input:focus]:shadow-ring-hover
rules: Leading icon size-4 text-fg-subtle; the inner input is bare (bg-transparent, no border, text-body-sm).
Buttons sit 8px apart and 8px from the bar edge, so they read as one inset group.
The run button is the brand button with its credit cost.

app-search-field.name: Toolbar search
app-search-field.use_for: The search field in a table toolbar ("Search keys").
app-search-field.not_for: Global search, which is the command palette.
app-search-field.tailwind: flex h-8 w-64 items-center gap-2 rounded-control border border-line px-3 text-body-sm transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 ease-out hover:border-line-strong focus-within:border-brand
rules: Search icon size-3.5 text-fg-subtle; inner input bare with placeholder text-fg-subtle.
Hero lists start it collapsed as a size-9 icon button that opens to w-56 with a brand border.

app-textarea.name: Textarea
app-textarea.use_for: Multi-line input: URL lists, feedback, instructions.
app-textarea.not_for: Code display, which is the code card.
app-textarea.tailwind: w-full resize-none rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-3.5 py-2.5 text-body-sm leading-[1.45] text-fg outline-none transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 ease-out placeholder:text-fg-subtle hover:border-line-strong focus:border-brand disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-danger
rules: Line height 1.45 in the dashboard (see missing_tokens; the micro line height token holds the same value).
URL lists use font-mono 12px and resize-y.

app-select.name: Select
app-select.use_for: A single choice from a list, beside form inputs or in a toolbar filter.
app-select.not_for: Two or three options in a form, which read better as a segmented control (app-tab, radio).
app-select.tailwind: flex h-10 w-full items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-3.5 text-body-sm text-fg transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:border-line-strong aria-expanded:border-accent
rules: Up-down chevrons (size-3.5 text-fg-subtle) at the right; never a down caret.
Toolbar filter (ghost): h-8 px-3 text-fg-muted, border-line-strong while open.
Chip form for card footers: h-7 rounded-control-sm px-2.5 text-caption bg-wash/4, bg-wash/6 on hover or open. The list is app-menu-panel.

app-switch.name: Switch
app-switch.use_for: On and off settings that apply at once: settings rows, parameter rows, auto top-up.
app-switch.not_for: Choices submitted with a form among several options.
app-switch.tailwind: relative inline-flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-pill bg-neutral-10 shadow-inset-hairline outline-none transition-[background-color,box-shadow] duration-200 ease-out aria-checked:bg-brand aria-checked:shadow-none focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
rules: Thumb sits 3/16 rem inside the track on every side; travel in rem so it scales with the root.
Thumb shadow stays soft; a dark one becomes a gray halo on blue.
One of the few round shapes allowed.

app-checkbox.name: Checkbox
app-checkbox.use_for: Picking several items from a list, such as the APIs a restricted key may call.
rules: Native checkbox tinted brand; the whole row is the label: flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-control px-2.5 py-2 text-body-sm, hover bg-wash/3.
Checked label text-fg, unchecked text-fg-muted.
Rows sit in a bordered box: grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-window border border-line p-1.5.

app-tags-input.name: Tags input
app-tags-input.use_for: Free-form lists typed one at a time: emails to invite, tags on a batch.
app-tags-input.not_for: Picking from a known list (select or checkboxes).
app-tags-input.tailwind: flex min-h-10 w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 ease-out focus-within:border-brand hover:border-line-strong
rules: Tag: h-6 rounded-control-sm pr-1 pl-2.5 text-caption bg-blue-10 text-accent; invalid bg-danger/8 text-danger.
Tag remove button size-4 rounded-sm, hover bg-brand text-on-brand.
Inner input h-7 min-w-24 flex-1 bare text-body-sm.

app-secret-field.name: Secret field
app-secret-field.use_for: Showing an API key or secret with reveal and copy.
app-secret-field.tailwind: flex h-9 min-w-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-control bg-surface-subtle pr-1 pl-3 shadow-inset-hairline
rules: Value in font-mono text-caption text-fg-muted, always as wide as its masked form so revealing never widens the field or its column.
Then a reveal icon button (size-7, hover bg-wash/5) and app-copy-button.
In a table cell cap it at w-full max-w-[300px].

app-field.name: Field
app-field.use_for: The wrapper that stacks a label, its control and one line of help or error.
app-field.not_for: Parameter rows in the playground panel.
rules: Label, control and message 8px apart; fields 28px apart in a page form, 24px in a dialog.
Help says "Optional." at its end instead of a label suffix.

app-field-message.name: Field help and error
app-field-message.use_for: The single line under a control: help text, replaced by the error when there is one.
rules: Errors only after the first submit attempt, and the control gets aria-invalid (danger border).
Errors say what to do: "Give the key a name so you can tell it apart."
Cost hints go here: "≈ 4.3K credits/mo · 1 credit/run".

app-parameter-row.name: Parameter row
app-parameter-row.use_for: One option in a dense settings panel (the playground parameters): label left, control right, description under.
rules: Rows live in one gray box per group: divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-window bg-neutral-5, 16px from the panel sides.
12px on every side of the control, switches included: the line is as tall as its control.
Controls are filled gray with no border (bg-wash/5, hover bg-wash/7); description mt-0.5 text-body-sm text-fg-muted.

app-choice-chip.name: Choice chip
app-choice-chip.use_for: Toggle chips for a small set of choices: output formats, feedback topics.
app-choice-chip.tailwind: h-8 rounded-control-sm border border-line px-3.5 text-body-sm text-fg-muted transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:border-line-strong hover:text-fg aria-pressed:border-brand aria-pressed:bg-blue-10/60 aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover
rules: Selected is a brand edge on a soft blue fill.
Formats sit in grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5.

app-card.name: Card
app-card.use_for: Any white content card on the canvas: tables, forms, charts, settings groups.
app-card.not_for: Floating panels (menus, dialogs), which are glass-frame.
rules: No border: the hairline is part of the shadow. No colored ring at rest.
Padding by density: 12px for stat and chart content, 16px default, 20px for settings and detail cards.
A card inside a card, or a quieter card, uses shadow-raised.

app-card-interactive.name: Clickable card
app-card-interactive.use_for: A card that is itself a link or button (overview cards, stat cards with a destination, help options).
rules: Hover wraps the card in the 4px translucent brand ring; it never lifts or deepens.
Its title words take the soft underline on group hover; arrows nudge.
Bordered clickable boxes (not cards) use glass-hover plus hover:border-line-strong.

app-card-header.name: Card header
app-card-header.use_for: The title row of a card: an optional 28px bordered glyph box, the title, one quiet action at the right.
app-card-header.tailwind: flex min-h-12 items-center gap-3 border-b border-line-subtle px-4 py-2.5
rules: Title text-body-sm text-fg, truncated.
Overview cards use the compact form: mb-2 gap-2.5 inside p-3, then a border-t border-line-subtle above the body.
Glyph box: size-7 rounded-control-sm border border-line with a size-4 brand glyph.

app-stat-card.name: Stat card
app-stat-card.use_for: A small card with one figure: credits used, remaining, current plan.
app-stat-card.tailwind: group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-col justify-between gap-3 rounded-window bg-surface p-3.5 text-left shadow-card
rules: Label text-caption text-fg-muted with an arrow when it links; footer text-caption text-fg-subtle.
Figure font-medium tabular-nums leading-none at 22px in the dashboard (text-h4 nearest), suffix text-caption text-fg-subtle.
Grid of four, two by two, gap-3. Sentence case labels.

app-chart-card.name: Chart card
app-chart-card.use_for: A card holding one usage chart with its picker and range switch.
app-chart-card.tailwind: flex h-64 min-w-0 flex-col rounded-window bg-surface p-2 shadow-card
rules: Head row mb-3 flex items-center gap-3: the breakdown picker doubles as the title, the range switch (app-tab sm) at the right.
Legend is one 28px line of 11px items under the chart, scrolling sideways rather than wrapping.
Height is 256px (h-64), written as calc(space-32 * 2) because no space-64 token exists.

app-code-card.name: Code card
app-code-card.use_for: Showing the API call that does what the page does, with language, fold and copy.
app-code-card.not_for: JSON responses (result card) or short inline code.
app-code-card.tailwind: flex min-h-0 flex-col rounded-window bg-surface text-fg shadow-card
rules: Code sits straight on the white card (not a dark block); lines wrap.
Footer holds the language chip select, the fold toggle and "Open in"; copy waits in the code's top-right corner.
Folded shows 5 lines with a fade from the surface color.

app-settings-section.name: Settings section
app-settings-section.use_for: A titled group on a settings page: a small label over a white card of rows or fields.
app-settings-section.not_for: Detail pages, which use the gray detail list.
rules: Title is app-text-section-label; the card is glass-card px-5 with divide-y divide-line-subtle rows.
A form card is glass-card flex flex-col gap-5 p-5.
Sections 24px apart.

app-settings-row.name: Settings row
app-settings-row.use_for: One setting inside a settings card: title and description left, its control right.
app-settings-row.tailwind: flex flex-col items-start gap-3 py-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-6
rules: Title text-body-sm; description text-body-sm text-fg-muted, mt-1 under a title.
Status leads the description in text-fg ("Not enabled.").
Control (switch, outline sm button) on the right.

app-detail-list.name: Detail list
app-detail-list.use_for: Read-only facts on a detail page or side panel: a soft gray box ruled between rows.
rules: Rows px-3.5 py-3 text-body-sm; inline rows flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4 with dd text-right tabular-nums text-fg-muted.
Section label above it is text-caption text-fg-subtle px-1, mt-2 gap.
The detail card around it: glass-card, head px-5 pt-5, body flex-col gap-6 px-5 pt-6 pb-5.

app-form-panel.name: Form panel
app-form-panel.use_for: A create or edit form on its own page: fields stacked, then a footer with the cost and the submit.
rules: Fields sit straight on the canvas (no card), 28px apart.
Footer: border-t border-line pt-6, cost line text-body-sm text-fg-muted ("Reserves 500 credits, one per page"), brand md submit ml-auto.
Guard against double submits; advanced options in a disclosure with a rotating chevron.

app-empty-state.name: Empty state
app-empty-state.use_for: A data view with nothing in it yet: a fine-dot picture, what the feature is for, one brand action.
app-empty-state.not_for: Filtered results with no match, which are one centered row in the table.
app-empty-state.tailwind: page-column my-auto flex flex-col items-center px-8 py-16 text-center
rules: Picture w-72, title mt-8 text-h4, body mt-1 max-w-120 text-body-sm text-balance text-fg-muted, actions mt-5 (brand plus optional outline "Read docs").
Inside a card: gap-3 py-8, title text-h5.
A dashed box (rounded-window border border-dashed border-line px-6 py-14) for a small empty list.

app-banner.name: Banner
app-banner.use_for: A limit or plan notice above a list ("You've used 2 of 3 API keys") with one outline action.
app-banner.not_for: Errors on a field, or marketing.
app-banner.tailwind: flex items-center gap-6 rounded-window bg-surface px-5 py-4 shadow-card max-sm:flex-col max-sm:items-start max-sm:gap-3
rules: A white card, not a tinted box: first line text-body-sm, second mt-1 text-body-sm text-fg-muted.
Outline sm action at the right ("View plans" with an arrow).
A success notice inline is rounded-control bg-success/10 px-3 py-2 text-caption text-success with a check.

app-quickstart-step.name: Quickstart step
app-quickstart-step.use_for: A numbered onboarding step inside the quickstart card (copy key, set up agent, prompt).
rules: Head flex min-h-7 items-center gap-2: number box size-5 rounded-control-sm border border-line text-micro, title text-body-sm.
Contents are bordered boxes (rounded-control border border-line), snippet body bg-surface-subtle with 11px mono.
Steps 16px apart in the card's scroll area.

app-sidebar.name: Sidebar
app-sidebar.use_for: The app's main navigation column beside the page.
app-sidebar.tailwind: flex h-full w-[212px] shrink-0 flex-col bg-canvas px-7
rules: 212px on the canvas, no border, no frame; workspace switcher and search at the top (pt-6 pb-2), account at the foot (pb-5).
Groups 6px apart, items 2px apart; group labels are a hairline tag: mt-3 mb-1 ml-3 w-fit rounded-control-sm border border-line px-1.5 text-micro text-fg-muted.
Below md it becomes app-drawer.

app-sidebar-item.name: Sidebar item
app-sidebar-item.tailwind: group/link relative flex h-8 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-control pr-2 pl-3 text-body-sm text-fg-muted outline-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-wash/4 hover:text-fg aria-[current=page]:bg-wash/7 aria-[current=page]:font-medium aria-[current=page]:text-neutral-80 focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover
rules: Icon size-4 stroke 1.75 in text-fg-subtle, text-fg-muted on hover, neutral-80 when current.
Current page is a 7% gray box with medium weight, a step short of black; neutral-80 re-points light in dark.
No animation when the list swaps (Data APIs to Back).

app-top-bar.name: Top bar
app-top-bar.use_for: The strip above every page: the mobile menu button and the credits menu at the right.
app-top-bar.not_for: Page titles or breadcrumbs; every page heads itself.
app-top-bar.tailwind: flex h-14 shrink-0 items-center gap-4 px-3 md:h-20 md:pr-4.5 md:pl-5
rules: No border, no fill: it sits on the canvas.
Level with the sidebar's workspace row.
56px on phones, 80px from md; no space-14 token, so the height is a calc of space-12 + space-2.

app-menu-trigger.name: Menu trigger
app-menu-trigger.use_for: A borderless control that opens a menu: workspace switcher, account menu, credits menu, card title pickers.
app-menu-trigger.tailwind: flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-control pr-2 pl-3 text-body-sm text-fg outline-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-wash/4 aria-expanded:bg-wash/4 focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover
rules: No fill at rest; a light wash on hover or while open.
Up-down chevrons size-3.5 text-fg-subtle right after the label.
Account trigger is h-9 w-full px-3 with a size-5 round brand avatar.

app-tab.name: Tab and segmented control
app-tab.use_for: Switching views (tabs) or picking one value in a form or chart (radio): plain labels with one soft gray pill that glides to the selection.
app-tab.tailwind: flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-control px-4 text-body-sm text-fg-subtle outline-none transition-colors duration-200 ease-out hover:text-fg aria-selected:text-fg focus-visible:shadow-ring-hover
rules: The group is relative isolate inline-flex gap-1 (gap-0.5 small); one pill span behind the tabs, bg-wash/6, glides on a spring (response 0.34, damping 0.82). Reduced motion jumps.
Only the text answers hover so nothing fades over the gliding pill; no borders, no underline.
Counts follow the label in tabular-nums (text-fg-muted selected, text-fg-subtle otherwise).

app-breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
app-breadcrumb.use_for: The head of a detail page: the list it belongs to, a chevron, then the item's ID.
app-breadcrumb.not_for: The top bar; it holds no breadcrumb.
rules: Parent link text-fg-subtle, hover text-fg; separator ChevronRight size-3.5 text-fg-subtle; current ID truncate font-mono text-caption.
Back links on forms: flex w-fit items-center gap-1.5 text-body-sm text-fg-subtle with an arrow size-4.

app-menu-panel.name: Menu and popover panel
app-menu-panel.use_for: The floating panel behind every dropdown, select list and popover.
app-menu-panel.tailwind: popover-in absolute z-30 mt-1.5 min-w-52 origin-top-left rounded-shell bg-surface p-1.5 shadow-floating
rules: Grows from 97% at the corner nearest its trigger in 150ms (popover-in); never from scale 0. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.
Rows stack 2px apart (flex flex-col gap-0.5); section labels px-2.5 pt-1 pb-1.5 text-caption text-fg-subtle; separators -mx-1.5 my-1 h-px bg-line-subtle.
Sits 6px off its trigger; read-only facts inside are bg-surface-subtle rows.

app-menu-item.name: Menu item
app-menu-item.use_for: A row in a menu or select list.
app-menu-item.tailwind: relative flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-control px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-body-sm whitespace-nowrap text-fg-muted outline-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-wash/4 hover:text-fg focus-visible:bg-wash/4 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40
rules: Icon size-3.5 stroke 1.5 before the label; a selected option shows a brand check at the right (invisible otherwise so widths hold).
Destructive items are danger text with a 6% danger wash; ones that cut off access hold for 1500ms with "Hold 1.5s" hint.
Descriptions under labels: mt-0.5 text-caption text-fg-subtle.

app-pagination.name: Pagination
app-pagination.use_for: Paging a table or list: the range at the left, Previous and Next at the right.
app-pagination.not_for: Infinite scroll; tables paginate 10 a page.
rules: Range text "1–10 of 248" with an en dash, text-fg-subtle tabular-nums.
Buttons are ghost text buttons with chevrons size-3.5.
Compact lists use size-7 icon chevrons around "1 / 4".

app-table.name: Table
app-table.use_for: Any data table: it sits in a white card whose header row rounds its own top corners.
rules: The wrapper does not clip (no overflow-hidden) so row menus open past the card; the header cells round themselves.
Hairlines between rows, none around the card. Fixed layout on phones so long values truncate.
Empty filtered result: one row, px-4 py-12 text-center text-fg-subtle.

app-table-header-cell.name: Table header cell
app-table-header-cell.use_for: Column headers: a light gray row in caption text.
app-table-header-cell.tailwind: bg-neutral-10/40 px-4 py-2.5 text-caption font-regular text-fg-subtle first:rounded-tl-window last:rounded-tr-window
rules: Regular weight, sentence case, no uppercase.
The actions column is w-12 with an aria-label and no text.
Lighter than the row hover would be on its own; the two must read apart.

app-table-row.name: Table row
app-table-row.use_for: A body row; it answers hover only when the whole row is clickable.
app-table-row.tailwind: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out data-clickable:cursor-pointer data-clickable:hover:bg-neutral-5/60 aria-selected:bg-blue-10/60
rules: Hover is gray at 60% of neutral-5, half the old strength, so it reads apart from the gray header; never a blue wash.
Selected row (its panel open) is blue-10 at 60%.
Rows that are not clickable get no hover.

app-table-cell.name: Table cell
app-table-cell.use_for: A body cell, including numeric and row-menu cells.
rules: Two-line cells: name in text-fg, meta under it text-caption text-fg-subtle.
Numbers right-aligned tabular; durations text-fg-subtle; times text-fg-muted.
The row menu cell (py-1.5) holds a size-8 kebab icon button and stops click propagation.

app-status-dot.name: Status dot and word
app-status-dot.use_for: An item's state in a cell or detail: a small colored dot and a word ("Active", "Running", "Failed").
app-status-dot.not_for: Filled badges; status is never a filled pill.
rules: Dots: success bg-success, running bg-brand, neutral bg-neutral-30, warning bg-alert, danger bg-alert-strong.
Compact labels in list rows are mono uppercase text-micro in the tone (optionally boxed rounded-control-sm border border-line px-1.5 py-0.5).
A dot in a soft ring (size-6 halo) can lead a row's title.

app-http-code-pill.name: HTTP code pill
app-http-code-pill.use_for: A response code in request lists: a hairline pill with a dot.
app-http-code-pill.tailwind: flex h-5 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control-sm border border-line px-2 text-caption text-fg-muted tabular-nums
rules: Dot size-1.5 rounded-pill: 2xx success, 4xx alert, 5xx alert-strong.
Tooltip with the meaning ("401 Key disabled").

app-badge.name: Badge and tag
app-badge.use_for: Small labels: counts beside a card title, plan chips, tags on an item, the "You" chip.
app-badge.tailwind: inline-flex h-5 items-center rounded-control-sm border border-line px-2 text-caption text-fg-muted tabular-nums
rules: Counts: hairline outline. Tags and plan chips: bg-blue-10 text-accent, no border. "You": bg-neutral-5 text-fg-subtle.
Square corners (6px), not round pills; only count dots on brand are round.
Never stack badges on badges; never an "OK" badge.

app-chart-series.name: Chart series colors
app-chart-series.use_for: Coloring bars, lines, dots and legend marks in usage charts.
app-chart-series.not_for: UI states; red stays reserved for errors.
rules: Fixed order: blue, teal, amber, violet; no bar borders; top corners of a stack rounded 3px.
Status charts: soft green success, amber 4xx, orange 5xx stacked on top; problems in the coral alert family.
Gridlines border-subtle; axis text 11px text-fg-subtle tabular; three date ticks (first, middle, last).

app-chart-tooltip.name: Chart hover card
app-chart-tooltip.use_for: The one small card every chart shows, pinned just off the pointer and following it.
app-chart-tooltip.tailwind: pointer-events-none fixed top-0 left-0 z-50 w-max min-w-40 rounded-control bg-surface px-2.5 py-2 text-caption shadow-floating
rules: Title font-medium text-fg and the total at the right; rows under a border-t border-line-subtle, each a size-1.5 dot, label text-fg-muted, value font-medium tabular, share text-fg-subtle.
Moves with the pointer at once, no easing; flips to stay in the window.
Zero rows hidden; "1 call" singular.

app-skeleton.name: Skeleton and loading
app-skeleton.use_for: Loading a data view: gray blocks laid out exactly like the real content, with a linear shimmer.
rules: Mirror the real page: same column, same block sizes (one line of text-h4, a 30px button, a 55px table row) so nothing shifts when data lands.
The page then enters with content-in (fade and 4px rise); pages whose cards rise on their own only fade.
A running job count may show a size-3.5 spinning loader in text-accent; reduced motion stops it.

app-progress-bar.name: Progress bar
app-progress-bar.use_for: A job's progress: done in brand and failed in alert on a neutral track.
app-progress-bar.not_for: Credit meters, which are rows of dots.
app-progress-bar.tailwind: relative h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-pill bg-neutral-10
rules: Segments scale on transform (scaleX), not width.
Pair with "120 / 500 pages" in text-caption text-fg-muted tabular-nums.

app-tooltip.name: Tooltip
app-tooltip.use_for: A short label for an icon button or a truncated value, on hover after a beat or on keyboard focus at once.
app-tooltip.not_for: Anything interactive or longer than a sentence.
app-tooltip.tailwind: pointer-events-none fixed z-50 rounded-control bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-micro text-fg whitespace-nowrap shadow-tooltip popover-in
rules: White (dark surface in dark) with a hairline, not a black bubble.
Waits 1000ms on hover; within 300ms of another closing it shows at once with no animation.
Sits 6px from its trigger, above or beside, and stays 8px inside the window.

app-dialog.name: Dialog
app-dialog.use_for: Confirms and short forms over the page: create key, delete, invite, plan change.
app-dialog.not_for: Marketing, or long flows that deserve a page.
rules: Header px-5 pt-5: title text-h5, description mt-1.5 text-body-sm text-fg-muted, close icon button pulled up and out (-mt-1.5 -mr-2).
Body p-5; footer flex justify-end gap-2 px-5 border-t border-line-subtle py-3.5 with ghost "Cancel" and the brand or hold confirm.
Rises 4px and fades over 200ms, centered horizontally, no transform origin; Escape and scrim click close.

app-scrim.name: Scrim
app-scrim.use_for: The wash behind a dialog, the command palette or the mobile drawer.
app-scrim.not_for: Blur; the page dims a touch, never blurs.
rules: 10% black in light, 50% in dark (the token re-points).
For a dialog the scrim scrolls (overflow-y-auto) and places the dialog near the top (pt-24, pt-4 on phones).
Drawer scrim fades with the drawer over 200ms instead of popping.

app-drawer.name: Drawer (mobile sidebar)
app-drawer.use_for: The sidebar below md: a floating panel that slides in from the left over the page.
app-drawer.tailwind: max-md:fixed max-md:inset-y-2 max-md:left-2 max-md:z-50 max-md:rounded-shell max-md:bg-surface max-md:shadow-drawer max-md:transition-[translate,visibility] max-md:ease-emphasized max-md:duration-250
rules: In over 250ms, out over a quicker 200ms; a transition, so a quick reopen turns around mid-way.
Opened from the top bar's menu button (size-9 icon button); Escape and scrim close it.
Reduced motion drops the slide.

app-side-panel.name: Side panel
app-side-panel.use_for: A floating detail panel over the right of a list, so opening it never reflows the table.
app-side-panel.tailwind: glass-frame absolute inset-y-4 right-4 z-20 flex w-[min(440px,calc(100%-2rem))] flex-col transition-[opacity,translate] duration-200 ease-emphasized starting:translate-x-2 starting:opacity-0
rules: Enters 200ms from 8px right with a fade (@starting-style), exits in 150ms; picking another row swaps contents without replaying the entrance.
Inner white box rounded-window; head px-5 pt-5 with text-h5 title and close; tabs sm under a border-b.

app-state-focus-visible.name: Keyboard focus
app-state-focus-visible.use_for: Keyboard focus on any control: the brand glass ring outside it.
app-state-focus-visible.not_for: Pointer focus; the ring shows on focus-visible only.
rules: The dashboard removed focus rings entirely; the system adds the 4px translucent brand ring for accessibility (ASSUMPTIONS 28).
Fields show focus as a brand border; cards as the glass-hover shadow; menu rows as a wash.
Never the browser outline.

app-state-hover-wash.name: Hover wash
app-state-hover-wash.use_for: Hover on rows, links, menu items and icon buttons: a faint wash, not a lift.
app-state-hover-wash.not_for: Bordered controls and cards, which get the glass ring.
rules: 4% for hover, 5% for small icon buttons, 6% to 7% for the selected item; black in light, white in dark.
Bordered things: glass-hover (border-color and the 4px brand ring, 150ms ease-out).
Only where a real pointer hovers: (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

app-state-pressed.name: Pressed
app-state-pressed.use_for: Pressing a button: it scales to 97%.
app-state-pressed.not_for: Rows, links and cards, which do not scale.
rules: Never scale from or to 0; reduced motion keeps size.
Copy chips press to 96% in the dashboard; the system uses 97% throughout.

app-state-disabled.name: Disabled
app-state-disabled.use_for: Controls that cannot be used right now.
app-state-disabled.not_for: Hidden permissions; explain with a tooltip ("Upgrade your plan to create more keys").
rules: Buttons and fields 50%; icon buttons, menu items and pager buttons 40%.
Wrap a disabled button in a tooltip that says why.
Buttons that swap to a spinner keep a min width so they do not jump.

app-state-selected.name: Selected and current
app-state-selected.use_for: The chosen item in a list, menu, table or nav.
rules: Nav: a 7% gray box. Table rows and history rows: blue-10 at 60%. Menus: text-fg plus a brand check. Tabs: the gliding gray pill.
Chips: brand edge on soft blue.
